about_the_game:
This EPIC Founder's Pack is packed full of exclusive content, rare buffs, and premium content to begin adventuring deep into the Forgotten Realms!

In this pack:

84 Platinum Chests
5 guaranteed Shiny loot cards
Exclusive Familiar
Exclusive Skin for Nayeli (Mythic Nayeli)
50,000 Gems
3 Epic Potions of the Gem Hunter
2 Epic Golden Potions
10 Epic Potions of Fire Breath
10 Epic Potions of Clairvoyance
10 Epic Potions of Giant's Strength
10 Epic Potions of Speed
10 Epic Blacksmithing Contracts
10 Epic Bounty Contracts
2,600 Platinum
